verdict.rationale: Xero shows some batch capability (exporting a payment file to pay multiple bills at once, marking them all paid) and offers a full API/SDK plus MCP server that could be scripted for bulk actions, but there's no explicit documentation of bulk create/update endpoints (e.g., batch invoice creation, bulk contact updates) for AI-driven mass operations. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints for invoices, contacts, or transactions; documented AI-native bulk workflows beyond bill payment export.
